summary: Frontend-only testing of LiveSection 2026 changes on the public URL (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844). Verified: 2026 header shows '8 eventi' and all 8 events render; the 4 new September events (COMICS STREET 2, BUSCA COMICS, IO STO CON VALE, DJ SET festa privata) are visible; the CSF Carmagnola event is styled in gold (rgb(212,175,55)), has an ExternalLink icon, is clickable via data-testid='csf-event-button' and opens data-testid='csf-modal' with the calendar image loading successfully (naturalWidth>0). Backdrop click closes the modal correctly and clicking the image does not close it. FAILURE: the modal close button (X) is unclickable on both desktop and mobile because the fixed navbar (z-index 100) overlays the modal (z-index 50).

ui_bugs.issue: Close (X) button cannot be clicked. Modal overlay uses z-50 while .navbar uses z-index:100, so the navbar (e.g. nav-youtube link) intercepts pointer events at the X position (rect top ~70px desktop, ~84px mobile). Playwright normal click times out; even a forced click lands on the navbar link instead of closing the modal. Same on mobile. Fix: raise modal z-index above the navbar (e.g. z-[200]) and/or hide navbar while modal is open; also consider positioning the X fixed relative to the viewport so it stays reachable when the tall image scrolls.
Top portion of the calendar image is hidden behind the fixed navbar (image starts under the 145px-tall navbar on desktop / behind the mobile header), so the flyer header is partially unreadable.
Escape key does not close the modal and page body scroll is not locked while the modal is open (a11y/UX polish).

issues: No visual issues found; gold highlight + external-link icon on the CSF row reads clearly against the dark background.

action_items: Increase CSF modal z-index above the navbar (navbar z-index=100) so [data-testid='csf-modal-close'] is clickable on desktop and mobile
Prevent the navbar from covering the modal image top (hide navbar when modal is open or add top padding/fixed close button)
Optional: close modal on Escape and lock body scroll while open
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line ~651: modal container className uses 'z-50' but the site navbar CSS z-index is 100 — modal is rendered below the navbar, breaking the close control. Also the modal is rendered inside the section rather than a portal, which makes stacking-context issues likely.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live 2026 content (8 events, 4 new September events, gold CSF row, modal open + backdrop close + image load) all verified working. Only remaining defect is the modal X button blocked by the navbar z-index; retest [data-testid='csf-modal-close'] with a normal (non-forced) Playwright click after the fix.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: stacking order. .navbar has z-index:100 (App.css) while the CSF modal overlay is Tailwind z-50 -> navbar paints above the modal and intercepts pointer events over the X button region (verified via document.elementFromPoint returning data-testid='nav-youtube'). Reproduction: open Live > 2026 > click CSF event > try to click X.
